source_task: Image semantic instance and panoptic segmentation
source_evidence: The official CVF paper reports similar state-of-the-art accuracy with a ViT-only encoder design and up to four-times faster prediction for ViT-L.
transfer_interface: Replace the dedicated 3D occupancy decoder with interleaved voxel or tri-plane tokens and mask queries updated inside one shared encoder; keep the view lift and occupancy head as controlled interfaces.
adaptation_hypothesis: Test whether decoder removal and joint token-query refinement preserve thin structures while reducing latency; this is a narrow 3D adaptation hypothesis rather than generic mask-query transfer.
query_problem: encoder-only mask transformer 3D occupancy autonomous driving
query_mechanism: plain transformer segmentation queries BEV semantic occupancy
search_sources: CVF proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;arXiv checked 2026-08-05;;Semantic Scholar checked 2026-08-05;;Crossref checked 2026-08-05;;official GitHub checked 2026-08-05
minimum_test: On one Occ3D validation protocol replace only the decoder; match backbone pretraining resolution schedule and supervision; report mIoU latency peak memory and thin-class IoU over three seeds.
rollback_baseline: The unchanged public occupancy baseline with its original decoder and the same backbone checkpoint.
falsifier: Remove the decoder change or restore the original decoder; if matched accuracy-efficiency Pareto does not improve or thin-object IoU degrades beyond the preset tolerance the transfer claim fails.
main_failure: Dense 3D token count can erase the 2D speed advantage and joint refinement may merge small or occluded structures.
public_boundary: 截至日期，在列明范围内本次未找到直接覆盖：只指在共享编码器内联合更新 3D occupancy tokens 与 mask queries 并移除专用 decoder 的窄组合；已有 3D mask-query 与 occupancy Transformer 工作不属于空白。

source_evidence: The official ICLR paper reports D-FINE-L and D-FINE-X at 54.0 and 55.8 COCO AP with 124 and 78 FPS on T4; Objects365 pre-training raises them to 57.1 and 59.3 AP.
transfer_interface: Replace direct continuous updates for center dimensions yaw and velocity with decoder-layer probability distributions; use cyclic bins or a circular distribution for yaw and preserve the detector matcher and backbone.
adaptation_hypothesis: Test whether coarse-to-fine distributions and layer-wise localization self-distillation improve hard 3D localization without breaking yaw periodicity or uncertainty calibration.
query_mechanism: fine-grained distribution refinement 3D bounding box detection
search_sources: OpenReview decision and paper checked 2026-08-05;;CVF proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;arXiv checked 2026-08-05;;Semantic Scholar checked 2026-08-05;;official GitHub checked 2026-08-05
minimum_test: On one public nuScenes validation detector change only the box refinement head; separately ablate center size yaw and velocity distributions; report NDS mAP mAOE mATE latency memory and calibration over three seeds.
rollback_baseline: The same detector with its original continuous regression head and matching loss weights.
falsifier: If gains disappear when compute and decoder depth are matched or if mAOE calibration and small-object recall worsen beyond the declared tolerance the adaptation is rejected.
main_failure: 3D parameter coupling and yaw periodicity can make independent bins inconsistent while dense distributions increase memory.
public_boundary: 截至日期，在列明范围内本次未找到直接覆盖：只指把 D-FINE 式逐层分布细化与自蒸馏用于自动驾驶 3D center size yaw velocity；RACE-6D 已覆盖分布式深度细化，故不能声称把该机制迁到所有 3D 任务都是新方向。

source_evidence: The official NeurIPS paper introduces exponential gating plus scalar and matrix memories and reports favorable scaling against Transformers and state-space models; matrix memory is parallelizable during training.
ad_target_task: Streaming BEV or object-query perception memory
transfer_interface: Insert mLSTM as prediction-relevant state after ego-motion alignment of BEV or object queries; define explicit per-scene read write reset detach and sequence-slot rules while leaving the spatial encoder and heads unchanged.
adaptation_hypothesis: Test whether matrix-valued memory stores multiple motion and occlusion modes better than a single previous-BEV buffer without creating train-test state leakage.
query_problem: xLSTM autonomous driving perception BEV occupancy tracking
query_mechanism: extended LSTM 3D object detection autonomous driving
search_sources: NeurIPS proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;ICLR proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;arXiv checked 2026-08-05;;Semantic Scholar checked 2026-08-05;;Google Research publication page checked 2026-08-05
minimum_test: Replace only the temporal memory in a streaming nuScenes detector; audit shuffled scene slots reset and detach; compare one-frame previous-BEV ConvGRU and mLSTM at matched state bytes over three seeds and corruption runs.
rollback_baseline: The public streaming model with its original previous-BEV or gated recurrent memory and identical spatial encoder.
falsifier: The hypothesis fails if matched-memory NDS tracking stability or occlusion recovery does not improve or if reset contamination and latency exceed the preset budget.
main_failure: Matrix memory can be expensive and numerically unstable; stale scene state or mismatched reset rules can silently contaminate predictions.
public_boundary: 截至日期，在列明范围内本次未找到直接覆盖：只指带严格 read write reset detach 审计的 xLSTM matrix memory 用于流式 BEV 或 object-query 感知；传统 LSTM 3D 检测与 xLSTM 轨迹预测已经存在。

source_task: Dense upsampling of low-resolution foundation features
source_evidence: FeatUp learns high-resolution features that preserve the semantics of a low-resolution foundation backbone and reports improvements across dense tasks.
transfer_interface: Use feature upsampling before view lifting or BEV fusion while preserving the base foundation encoder.
adaptation_hypothesis: The generic interface looks attractive but a direct autonomous-driving BEV study already evaluates FeatUp and develops a stronger task-specific alternative.
query_problem: foundation feature upsampling autonomous driving BEV
query_synonym: high resolution DINO features bird eye view
search_sources: ICLR proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;OpenReview checked 2026-08-05;;official JAFAR project checked 2026-08-05;;CVF proceedings checked 2026-08-05
minimum_test: Reproduce the JAFAR matched BEV segmentation table before proposing any new upsampler variant.
rollback_baseline: The low-resolution public BEV backbone without learned feature upsampling.
falsifier: Any proposed delta must beat the published FeatUp and JAFAR controls at matched resolution and compute; otherwise no opportunity remains.
main_failure: Upsampled semantics can look sharper without improving metric geometry and can add large dense-feature memory.
public_boundary: Direct BEV evaluation exists in JAFAR so FeatUp is retained only as a collision record and is not highlighted as an unused transfer.

source_evidence: The official paper reports 40-60 percent FLOPs savings with about 0.3-0.5 point average drops on selected vision-language and classification settings under its protocols.
ad_target_task: Efficient point cloud and multi-view 3D perception
transfer_interface: Merge redundant spatial tokens while attempting to preserve small isolated structures and graph spectrum.
adaptation_hypothesis: The broad transfer is already covered by point-cloud and autonomous-driving token compression work; only a narrower calibration and motion-aware variant might remain and needs a new collision audit.
query_problem: PiToMe point cloud autonomous driving token merging
search_sources: NeurIPS proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;arXiv checked 2026-08-05;;Semantic Scholar checked 2026-08-05;;CVF and official project pages checked 2026-08-05
minimum_test: First reproduce token-count accuracy and latency curves from GitMerge3D and ToC3D on one public backbone before defining a narrower variant.
rollback_baseline: The uncompressed backbone plus published ToC3D and generic PiToMe controls.
falsifier: If a geometry-aware delta cannot outperform existing merging controls at matched token count wall-clock latency and small-object metrics the remaining opportunity is rejected.
main_failure: Merging can destroy rare small actors or cross-view geometry; the repository license is non-commercial and requires legal review.
public_boundary: Point-cloud PiToMe adaptation and driving token compression are already public; the radar therefore records only partial remaining scope and does not highlight it.

source_evidence: The official NeurIPS paper trains sequences with independently sampled noise levels and evaluates flexible-horizon generation planning and decision-making.
transfer_interface: Apply independent per-time noise schedules to long driving rollouts to bridge causal next-step prediction and full-sequence denoising.
adaptation_hypothesis: The transfer is no longer an open opportunity because a public driving world model explicitly uses Diffusion Forcing pre-training.
query_problem: Diffusion Forcing autonomous driving world model
query_mechanism: per-token diffusion noise driving video rollout
search_sources: NeurIPS proceedings checked 2026-08-05;;arXiv checked 2026-08-05;;official Orbis 2 project checked 2026-08-05;;CVF proceedings checked 2026-08-05
minimum_test: Treat Orbis 2 as the direct prior and reproduce its stated Diffusion Forcing contribution before proposing a distinct mechanism.
rollback_baseline: A matched autoregressive or standard video-diffusion driving world model.
falsifier: A new claim must isolate a mechanism not already present in Orbis 2; merely changing the backbone or dataset does not pass.
main_failure: Long rollout quality can improve visually while geometry action consistency and rare-event calibration remain poor.
public_boundary: Orbis 2 publicly states Diffusion Forcing pre-training in a driving world model so this mechanism is recorded as covered rather than advertised as unused.

source_task: Contrastive fine-tuning that mimics image-text pretraining
source_evidence: The official CVPR paper reports 4.2 percent average OOD gains over standard fine-tuning across seven distribution-shift datasets and gains up to 4.6 percent on three few-shot benchmarks under its source protocols.
ad_target_task: Robust adaptation of CLIP image backbones for BEV perception
transfer_interface: Retain the CLIP contrastive image-text objective while adapting the image backbone and a BEV task interface; compare against direct fine-tuning staged head alignment and WiSE-FT.
adaptation_hypothesis: The broad transfer is already directly covered by RoboBEV's CLIP head-alignment study and generic robust fine-tuning methods; FLYP is a source-domain control that requires text prompts and is not an unused driving opportunity.
query_problem: CLIP fine-tuning loses OOD robustness in BEV perception
query_mechanism: contrastive fine-tuning frozen backbone head alignment robust adaptation
query_synonym: foundation vision encoder staged adaptation autonomous driving corruption
search_sources: CVF proceedings checked 2026-08-06;;OpenReview and arXiv checked 2026-08-06;;OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar style indexes checked 2026-08-06;;official RoboBEV FLYP and WiSE-FT repositories checked 2026-08-06
minimum_test: Reproduce RoboBEV direct fine-tuning and head-alignment rows then add FLYP at matched CLIP checkpoint data steps and inference cost.
rollback_baseline: The same BEV detector with its original backbone plus direct CLIP end-to-end fine-tuning RoboBEV head alignment and WiSE-FT.
falsifier: If FLYP does not improve unseen-corruption absolute NDS calibration or long-tail metrics over matched direct staged and interpolation controls it is retained only as a negative control.
main_failure: Contrastive prompts may not encode metric 3D geometry and the text branch can add training cost without improving BEV localization.
public_boundary: RoboBEV already transfers robust CLIP adaptation to BEV and generic robust fine-tuning is mature; this record is a collision and rollback baseline not a highlighted opportunity.
